chunks: And in the narration of Hariz, he said:
"If a woman has jewelry that she did not acquire for ihram, she does not remove her jewelry."

key_terms.الْإِحْرَامِ: the consecrated state for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman, referring to the female pilgrim
key_terms.تُحْدِثْهُ: she newly acquires or introduces it
key_terms.حَرِيزٍ: Hariz, the narrator cited in this report

ai.seo_question: Does a woman have to remove jewelry during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning what a woman may wear in the state of ihram. It indicates that if her jewelry was not newly acquired specifically for ihram, she is not required to remove it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2639 - In a narration from Hariz, he said:
"If a woman has jewelry that she did not acquire specifically for Ihram, she does not need to remove her jewelry."
